1.consolidated_definition: espec. Payaso. Cómico de pantomima o circo que usa vestimenta y maquillaje tradicional. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. DRAE 2001, voz inglesa. Aclara Israel que, en Puerto Rico, existe una visión tergiversada del payaso o clown, en gran medida cimentada por la cantidad de personas que, para generar dinero, se pintan la cara, se enganchan un disfraz colorido y, con cualquier remoquete que se les ocurra, se ponen a amenizar cumpleaños y bautizos sin poseer un mínimo de preparación artística (Fundación Nacional para la Cultura Popular, 30-03-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Clown. Specifically, a comedian of pantomime or circus who uses traditional costume and makeup. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. (DRAE 2001, English word). It is clarified that in Puerto Rico, there exists a distorted view of the clown, largely based on the number of people who, to generate income, paint their faces, attach colorful costumes, and with any nickname they can think of, attend birthday parties and baptisms without possessing a minimum of artistic preparation (National Foundation for Popular Culture, 30-03-08).
